title: Felix and the Safehouse
author: Freya Dunmore
blurb: Xanthe Reyes, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
